messages:
maria: Kicking off staggered rollout for runtime v2.3 — US->EU->APAC. Need capacity sanity and pin guidance. Window tonight 23:00-02:00 UTC. Deploybot will run canaries. @deploy-bot stand by.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy v2.3 to begin at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary slices: 0.5% US, 1% EU. Health checks: 5m latency, 99.9% success. Reply 'go' to start canary.

lee: Quick capacity read: US reserved pool at 82% but warm pool has ~200 extra tokens/sec headroom. EU reserved at 68%. APAC warmup still low (45%) — will need warmup by +2h.

anjali: Re: APAC — can we delay APAC > 01:00 UTC to allow warm pool spin? I'd prefer US/EU first, then APAC if warm.

sam: Agree with anjali. Also recommend pinning fallback model to rdlw-quant-1 for APAC in case of perf regressions.

maria: Okay plan: US canary at T0, EU follow T0+30m, APAC at T0+2h if warm. Pin fallback model for APAC. Adding release notes URL: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3

ops-lead: Rollback triggers (if DeployBot sees): 1) 5m rolling error rate > 2x baseline AND abs error >0.5%. 2) P90 latency > 2x baseline for 5m. 3) Increased token cost >5% with drop in quality. If triggered, immediate version-pin to previous stable and drain new nodes.

lee: Load test snippet we ran:
```bash
curl -X POST https://canary-redwood/load -d '{"rps":2000,"seq":512}'
```
Results: no OOM, p95 latency +12ms.

deploy-bot: await 'go' from ops or maria to initiate. Current checks: US warm pool ok, EU ok, APAC below warm threshold.

maria: @ops-lead @lee I'm giving 'go' for US canary. EU go on in 30. APAC on hold until warm metric >= 80%.

deploy-bot: US canary STARTED. Canary slice: 0.5%. Monitoring hooks: tracing, cost-meter, quality-eval.

anjali: Watching metrics. If we see model regressions in quality-eval (delta > 3% on prompt set), we'll rollback immediately.

sam: Reminder: release notes include known perf tuning changes and quantization fallback. Patch notes added by @maria.

deploy-bot: US canary passing at 15m. Error rate within baseline, p95 latency - nominal. Proceed EU canary in 10m? Reply 'proceed-eu'.

lee: proceeding with EU in 5m. Initiating extra warmup: hitting APAC warm pool with synthetic traffic to reduce spinup time.

maria: EU canary PROCEED. APAC warmup: continue synthetic until threshold reached. I'll update release channel after APAC decision.

deploy-bot: EU canary STARTED. Canary slice 1%. Observability hooks live.

ops-lead: Note for rollback: if EU shows any region-specific disk pressure or OOMs, we abort and roll back EU only (regional rollback supported).

deploy-bot: EU canary passing 10m mark. No regressions. APAC warm pool at 79% (still below). Waiting for +1% to auto-schedule.

maria: APAC at 80% now. Scheduling APAC at T0+2h as planned. @deploy-bot schedule APAC at 01:05 UTC.

deploy-bot: APAC scheduled at 2026-03-22T01:05:00Z. Canary slice 0.5%. Will pin fallback to rdlw-quant-1 for APAC if any degradation detected.

sam: Heads up: I'll be oncall for APAC window. Ping me on pager if token cost delta >4% or quality drop >2%.

anjali: Thanks — watching quality-eval dashboard.

deploy-bot: APAC canary STARTED. Initial metrics streaming.

maria: All three region canaries done. EU/US green. APAC mid-canary showing slight p95 bump +30ms — monitoring.

lee: p95 bump correlates with one specific shard; scaling up shard group 3 should mitigate. Triggering autoscale now.

deploy-bot: Autoscale completed for shard group 3. p95 returning to baseline.

ops-lead: If anything persists beyond 10m post-autoscale, we roll APAC back. Otherwise finalize rollout and publish release note in #releases.

maria: Confirm finalize. I'll post release summary and links to change window notes and release artifacts.

deploy-bot: Rollout COMPLETE. v2.3 promoted. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3/notes

sam: Nice work team :tada:

anjali: Good job. Leaving a follow-up item to run post-deploy cost delta analysis tomorrow.

maria: Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
